evals.prompt: I'm starting a new data platform for our fintech company. We need to define a DataSpec workspace for a payment processing system. We have a PostgreSQL database as our main source with tables for transactions, merchants, and payouts. Data goes to an S3 data lake first, then gets transformed with dbt and loaded into a ClickHouse analytics warehouse. Can you create all the dataspec YAML files for this?
evals.expected_output: A complete dataspec/ directory with platform.yaml, source files, contract files, dataset files, and a flow file, all correctly cross-referenced
expectations: Creates a dataspec/ directory with platform.yaml
platform.yaml defines at least one storage backend (s3 or clickhouse)
platform.yaml defines at least one engine (dbt)
Creates source files for the PostgreSQL database
Creates contract files with proper field types (uuid, string, integer, timestamp)
Creates dataset files that reference storage backends from platform.yaml
Creates at least one flow file with extract, transform, and load steps
All cross-references between resources are valid (source names, contract names, dataset names, engine names)
The skill correctly reads reference files to understand syntax

evals.prompt: I have an existing DataSpec workspace for my e-commerce platform. I need to add a new Kafka streaming source for real-time inventory events. The topic is called 'inventory-updates' on our Kafka cluster at kafka.internal:9092. Each event has: inventory_id (uuid, required), product_id (uuid, required), warehouse_id (string), quantity_changed (integer, required), change_type (string — 'restock' or 'sale'), and event_timestamp (timestamp, required). I also need to wire it into a new flow that extracts from Kafka and loads to a raw dataset in our S3 lake.
evals.expected_output: New source YAML, contract YAML, dataset YAML, and flow YAML files for the Kafka inventory streaming pipeline
expectations: Creates a streaming source YAML with type 'streaming' and protocol 'kafka'
Source includes baseUrl for the Kafka cluster
Creates a contract with all specified fields (inventory_id, product_id, warehouse_id, quantity_changed, change_type, event_timestamp)
Contract uses correct data types for each field
Contract marks required fields with not_null: true
Creates a dataset YAML for the raw inventory data
Creates a flow with extract step from the Kafka source
Flow includes load step to the target dataset
The skill reads source reference to understand streaming source syntax

evals.prompt: Can you look at my dataspec workspace and explain the relationship between my sources, contracts, datasets, and flows? I want to understand the data lineage — which sources feed which datasets through which flows. Also tell me if there are any orphaned resources or validation issues.
evals.expected_output: A clear explanation of the dependency graph, data lineage, and any issues found in the workspace
expectations: Reads the workspace structure to understand existing resources
Explains the relationship between sources, contracts, datasets, and flows
Identifies which sources feed which datasets through which flows
Checks for orphaned resources (unused sources, contracts, datasets)
Identifies validation issues (missing references, invalid types)
The skill reads workspace reference to understand validation rules
